PermissionPresetName.description:
Permission presets — verdict-keyed pattern lists in the same shape `parseRules` accepts. The TUI exposes these as `--preset strict`, `--preset readonly`, etc.; the manager resolves the chosen preset to the structured `Rule<string>[]` at construction.

Pattern grammar:   "bash(ls:*)"     → bash command pattern   "read(/src/**)"  → workspace-relative gitignore pattern   "read(*)"        → matches every read in any workspace   "bash"           → bare scope, equivalent to `bash(*)` (match any cmd)

Scope names are exact matches against the tool name they gate (snake_case). Underscored scopes work too (`task_stop`, `task_poll`).

enabled.description: Whether the plugin is enabled. Defaults to true.

exclude.description: When set, exclude the resources, matching these paths/globs from the plugin. Add a resource type to the exclude list to disable that resource type. For example, `["skills"]` will disable all skills from the plugin. Exclude is applied after include.

include.description: When set, only include the resources, matching these paths/globs from the plugin.

actionPrefix.description: Prefix for command actions. Defaults to ``

bash.description: Allow bash execution in commands. Defaults to true.

expr.description: Allow js expressions in command templates. Defaults to true.

backgroundEnabled.description: Start automatic compaction without pausing the foreground agent.

backgroundThreshold.description: Context ratio at which background compaction starts.

enabled.description: Enable automatic compaction when context is full

keepTokens.description: Existing messages up to this many tokens will be preserved in the context

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort for the compaction summary

summaryTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to use for the generated summary

threshold.description: Context ratio at which the agent waits for compaction before continuing.

delta.description: How far above the target ratio to trigger a new masking pass. Defaults to 0.25 (25%).

enabled.description: Whether to enable masking. Defaults to true.

keepTurns.description: How many turns to keep in the tail of the conversation, regardless of score. Defaults to 20.

minTokens.description: Don't mask tool-result parts whose original content is shorter than this (estimated tokens). Skips tiny "ok"-style success messages where the stub would be larger than the original. Doesn't apply to attachments (always worth masking).

target.description: Target ratio of used/limit tokens to reach by masking. Defaults to 0.5 (50%).

model.description: Default model to use for the agent.

preset.description: Permissions preset to use. Defaults to "permissive".

actionPrefix.description: Prefix for command actions. Defaults to `skill:`, e.g `/skill:SKILL_NAME`

actions.description: Show skill actions. Defaults to true.

enabled.description: Allow skills to be used by the agent. Defaults to true.

bash.description: Command used by the bash tool.

npm.description: Package manager command used for npm packs.

collapsedTools.description: Tools whose result body should be hidden in the UI.

images.description: Render images, if supported by the terminal

listHeight.description: Maximum number of visible rows in selection lists, like pickers and autocomplete.

mode.description: Terminal display mode. Scrollback preserves terminal history/search; fullscreen uses an alternate screen with a fixed footer.

reasoning.description: Whether to show the reasoning trace in the UI.

sessionTree.description: What messages to show in the session tree. Defaults to assistant, reasoning, and tools.

shiki.description: Syntax highlighting: auto uses the theme's Shiki counterpart or generates from its syntax slots; a bundled name overrides it.

theme.description: Theme name or path to custom theme file

transparent.description: Make the background transparent. Defaults to false.

treeHeight.description: Maximum number of visible rows in the session tree.
